items.title: National Health Insurance Is Ideal, But Are We Ready To Pay For It? — David Lim
items.summary: We want better health care. But we also very clearly want to keep paying less for fuel and less in taxes. We can't consistently have both. National health insurance (NHI) might still be the right destination, but the clear path forward right now isn't NHI. items.title: Different Paths To Universal Coverage: Exploring Health Financing Models
items.summary: A hybrid model should raise public health expenditure to 5% of GDP and introduce a publicly administered health insurance option with community-rated premiums, guaranteed coverage for pre-existing conditions, and genuine competition with private insurers.
